qt: to the Commission Cecilia Strada (S&D), Rudi Kennes (The Left), Benedetta Scuderi (Verts/ALE), Aodhán Ó Ríordáin (S&D), Mimmo Lucano (The Left), Villy Søvndal (Verts/ALE), Rasmus Nordqvist (Verts/ALE), Hilde Vautmans (Renew), Per Clausen (The Left), Barry Andrews (Renew), Maria Zacharia (NI), Estelle Ceulemans (S&D), Evin Incir (S&D), Brando Benifei (S&D), Nacho Sánchez Amor (S&D), Leoluca Orlando (Verts/ALE), Maria Ohisalo (Verts/ALE), Nela Riehl (Verts/ALE), Catarina Vieira (Verts/ALE), Rima Hassan (The Left), Lynn Boylan (The Left), Catarina Martins (The Left), Ana Miranda Paz (Verts/ALE), Mounir Satouri (Verts/ALE), Hana Jalloul Muro (S&D), Tineke Strik (Verts/ALE), Hanna Gedin (The Left), Jonas Sjöstedt (The Left), Sandro Ruotolo (S&D), Marc Botenga (The Left), César Luena (S&D), Thomas Bajada (S&D), Sirpa Pietikäinen (PPE), Matjaž Nemec (S&D), João Oliveira (The Left), Alessandra Moretti (S&D), Saskia Bricmont (Verts/ALE), Mélissa Camara (Verts/ALE), Ilaria Salis (The Left), Marco Tarquinio (S&D), Dario Tamburrano (The Left), Daniel Attard (S&D), Annalisa Corrado (S&D), Marit Maij (S&D), Alessandro Zan (S&D), Irene Tinagli (S&D) Subject:

In its replies to Written Questions E-001633/20261 and E-000112/20262, the Commission states that the customs surveillance system3 does not collect information on goods entering the EU from Israeli settlements, and that national customs authorities do not possess tools to notify the Commission when products coming from illegal Israeli settlements in the OPTs enter the EU. In the light of the EU differentiation policy towards products coming from the illegal Israeli settlements, the violation of which, through mislabelling or other practices, would constitute customs fraud against EU countries, could the Commission clarify: 1.

why the customs surveillance system does not collect data regarding imports from illegal Israeli settlements, and if the Commission is willing to collect these data in the light of the trade restriction mechanisms that several Member States have put in place or are willing to put in place;
whether the Commission collects information regarding requests for assistance in customs matters sent by Member States to the Israeli authorities4;
if the EU-Israel association agreement provides for the temporary suspension of preferential treatment in cases of customs fraud5?

of the other part. 6 This question is supported by a Member other than the authors: Matteo Ricci (S&D).
